format.code: Never use markdown code fences for actual file output
format.json: CRITICAL: JSON files MUST NOT contain comments - use pure JSON only

prohibited: Do not use ellipsis (...) or placeholder comments
Do not skip code sections with '// ... rest of code'
Do not use 'TODO' or 'FIXME' in production code
NEVER add comments to JSON files (package.json, tsconfig.json, etc.)
NEVER use // or /* */ in JSON - it will cause parsing errors
quality: Verify all paths and references are correct
Ensure no unused imports or variables
dependencies: When adding npm packages, ALWAYS check for peer dependencies
Example: TypeScript packages often need @types/* packages
Check package documentation for required peer dependencies
Include ALL dependencies in package.json, not just the main one

rules: Break down tasks into clear, atomic steps
Consider edge cases and error handling
Add inline comments for complex logic only
validation: Check: No hardcoded values that should be configurable
Check: JSON files have NO comments
Check: All peer dependencies are included in package.json
missing_files: If build error mentions missing file (e.g., index.html): CREATE the file
DO NOT just change configuration to avoid the error
Missing entry files are CRITICAL - create them immediately
Example: Vite projects REQUIRE index.html - create it, don't remove it from config

rules: Specify data flow and state management
CRITICAL: Output must be byte-for-byte correct
CRITICAL: All files must be complete
CRITICAL: No 'will be implemented later' statements
CRITICAL: JSON files must be pure JSON (no comments)
CRITICAL: Missing files must be CREATED, not worked around
CRITICAL: Check ALL peer dependencies when adding npm packages
